senses.gloss: pr. n.Be-Hozaë, a district, on the caravan road, along the Tigris and its canals.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 51b:11">Sabb. 51ᵇ</cite> sent money <he>לבי ח׳ וכ׳</he> to (the merchants in) Be-H. to buy him a Lybian ass (v. Neub. Géogr. p. 380).
<cite ref="Taanit 21b:11">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>איכא מותנא בי ח׳</he> there is an epidemic in B. H.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 85a:4">Keth. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו מסקי … בי ח׳</he> men of B. H. had a claim against him.—Denom. <cite ref="H00283"><he>חוֹזָאָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 41b:12">Ab. Zar. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>רב חנינא ח׳</he>; <cite ref="Shabbat 130b">Sabb. 130ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
